title: Compatible finite-free approximation triangle before cohomology comparison
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $m\in\mathbf Z$, and $T=(A\to B\to C\to A[1])$ a distinguished triangle in $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Suppose $A$ is $(m+1)$-pseudo-coherent and $B$ is $m$-pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-m-pseudo-coherent]. There exist a bounded complex $E^\bullet$ of finite free $R$-modules, a distinguished triangle $S$, and a morphism of triangles $\varphi:S\to T$, with $S_3=Q(E^\bullet)$, such that $H^i(\varphi_1)$ is an isomorphism for $i>m+1$ and an epimorphism for $i=m+1$, and $H^i(\varphi_2)$ is an isomorphism for $i>m$ and an epimorphism for $i=m$. No assertion about $H^i(\varphi_3)$ is made.

source.place: Tag 064R, proof of lemma-cone-pseudo-coherent, assertion (1), through the construction of the morphism of distinguished triangles

proof.text: Unpack the finite-free witnesses P -> A and F -> B. Replace P by its brutal truncation in degrees >= m+1. This keeps finite-free terms and boundedness. Above m+1 the cohomology is unchanged; at m+1 its cycles surject onto the original cohomology, so the composite to A remains epi there. The truncated P vanishes below m.

Represent B by a complex L using essential surjectivity of Q, transporting F -> B and P -> A -> B through the chosen isomorphism. The finite-free terms of P are projective. Apply the derived map lift at n=m to obtain a chain map gamma:P -> F whose image in D(R) composes to P -> A -> B.

Take the mapping cone E of gamma. Its terms are F^i direct sum P^{i+1}, so they are finite free and vanish outside a bounded interval. The cone triangle S is distinguished. TR3 extends the commuting square to phi:S -> T. Its first two maps are the chosen approximations and hence have the claimed homology conditions. The third map has not yet been analyzed.

theorem exists_pseudoCoherent_approximation_triangle
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{v} R)]
    (m : ℤ) (T : Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} R)))
    (hT : T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} R)))
    (hA : IsMPseudoCoherent (m + 1) T.obj₁)
    (hB : IsMPseudoCoherent m T.obj₂) :
    ∃ (E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) (a b : ℤ),
      E.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ E.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free R (E.X i) ∧ Module.Finite R (E.X i)) ∧
      ∃ (S : Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} R))) (φ : S ⟶ T),
        S ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} R)) ∧ S.obj₃ = Q.obj E ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, m + 1 < i →
          IsIso ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) i).map φ.hom₁)) ∧
        Epi ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) (m + 1)).map φ.hom₁) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, m < i →
          IsIso ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) i).map φ.hom₂)) ∧
        Epi ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) m).map φ.hom₂)
